admission_gates: Download source bytes from the listed source, not through a paraphrase or screenshot.
Record UTC acquisition time, final resolved URI, HTTP metadata where available, byte length, and SHA-256 calculated over the exact retained bytes.
Review licence, terms, citation requirements, revisions, errata, data units, experimental conditions, and relevance to the intended model domain.
Write a parser with fixtures and negative controls; preserve the raw source unchanged.
Independently re-calculate parsed point counts, units, and selected values; reject missing values, unit ambiguity, non-finite values, duplicate keys, and partial downloads.
Keep NASA high-Reynolds-number solver validation distinct from UIUC low-Reynolds-number airfoil/application validation.
Only change admission_status after all relevant evidence is retained and reviewed. Never convert a null hash to a pass.
